subject.title: fix: keep mapped hook content provenance scoped [AI]

question: Should this PR intentionally make Gmail provenance path/session-key scoped even for mappings whose request body says `source: gmail`?
rationale: That is the security fix, but it can change custom Gmail mappings that relied on caller-provided body source for Gmail model or unsafe-content behavior.

options.title: Accept Provenance Tightening
options.body: Land this fix with release-note or PR-body context that Gmail provenance comes from `/hooks/gmail` or `hook:gmail:` session keys, not caller-controlled body fields.

options.title: Add Explicit Compatibility Path
options.body: Before merge, add or document a mapping-owned provenance field if maintainers want body-source-only Gmail adapters to keep Gmail behavior without trusting arbitrary payloads.

options.title: Pause For Deployed-Config Evidence
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers believe body-source-only Gmail mappings are a shipped operator contract that needs migration guidance.

recommendation.title: Accept Provenance Tightening
recommendation.body: Land this fix with release-note or PR-body context that Gmail provenance comes from `/hooks/gmail` or `hook:gmail:` session keys, not caller-controlled body fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway hook and external-content history makes this the best available owner for the provenance and compatibility choice.
